text:
release-manager: Holding tonight's change window for v2.14.0 — deploybot failed during the artifact upload/cache step, looks like a partial layer. Pin or rerun? Need decision.
aj: Saw it. deploybot logs show a 504 during multipart finalize to artifact-store, then manifest mismatch on promote. Reproducible on runner-7.
deploy-bot: deploybot: upload abort detected for artifact 'webapp:v2.14.0' (sha:ef12ab). Marked FAILED; promoted last_good 'webapp:v2.13.7'.
maria: Are we okay to pin to v2.13.7 and cut the release? Customers expect the patch.
lucas: Prefer pin + reupload later. Reupload might succeed but holding the window is painful. To pin: `/deploy promote --image webapp:v2.13.7 --force-pin`
aj: I can trigger a re-run of the artifact job once we pin. But we should surface the cache TTL / s3 multipart backoff — looks like a race on stale cache-key.
sre-ops: Checking artifact-store logs now. There's a GC job that ran ~4m before the upload; might've removed temp parts. Filing INC-485 to track.
release-manager: Decision: pin to v2.13.7 for immediate cut. @aj do the promote and then trigger a re-upload job for v2.14.0 in staging. I'll update release notes & announce rollback policy.
aj: :thumbsup: Running promote now
```bash
/deploy promote --image webapp:v2.13.7 --change-window 2026-03-23T20:00Z --reason "artifact upload fail"
```
deploy-bot: deploybot: promote succeeded, release pinned to webapp:v2.13.7. New release tag: 2026-03-23-pin. Notifying release channel.
maria: Thanks. Can someone add a short note in the release notes about 'deferred v2.14.0 due to artifact upload failure' and link INC-485?
release-manager: Already added. Follow-up action owners: @sre-ops for artifact GC tuning, @aj for reupload pipeline and retry/backoff improvements. Closing thread for now.
